findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations under Section 8 are explicitly excluded from the overall liability cap, leaving your potential liability for third-party intellectual property claims completely uncapped.
findings.suggested_change: In no event shall either party's total liability arising out of this Agreement, including any liability arising under Section 8, exceed the total amount actually paid by Corio hereunder for the transaction to which the liability relates during the twelve (12) months immediately prior to the filing of the cause of action.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a small adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms exclude Section 8 from the overall liability cap, which leaves potential liability uncapped. I suggest modifying the agreement so that liability under Section 8 is included within the total liability cap. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
